description: Run Fudge’s free Shopify Knowledge Base report: 15 shopper questions with the exact answers, gaps and conflicts with published information. Takes 2–5 minutes and waits up to 45 seconds. Returns a run in progress or a result from the last 24 hours unless `fresh` is true.

domain.description: The Shopify storefront to check, e.g. example.com. Required until a store is connected; afterwards, omit it to use a connected store.

fresh.description: Start a new run even when a result from the last 24 hours exists.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: run_knowledge_base_check
title: Run Knowledge Base check
